The end card is in `./s5/`, and `npx hyperframes check` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings. I didn't render it to video or look at snapshot frames.

- **Layout:** it's a 3-second, 1920×1080 composition. `index.html` mounts one scene, `compositions/end.html`.
- **Reveal:** `github.com` is on screen at frame 0 in lime. `/mohessaid/girth` then wipes in left to right, and a lime rule draws underneath. A slow scale-up carries the card to the end so it doesn't sit still.
- **Style:** JetBrains Mono on near-black charcoal with a lime accent. I picked it because your last cards used Inter on dark navy with a fade-rise.
- **Check:** my first draft passed with 3 warnings. It declared no `url` variable, had nested elements outside a sub-composition, and frame 0 showed only the background. I fixed those by moving the scene into a sub-composition and keeping the host visible at the start.
- **Project files:** `package.json`, `hyperframes.json` and `meta.json` follow the sibling `s1`–`s4` projects.

Girth also saved a skill at `.claude/skills/girth-hyperframes/` with the HyperFrames conventions and the check command. I recorded this card's choices in your taste history.
